posts.text: Auditor Review - Clarification Krishna Chandra: ”The way I would look at it is, just to answer, just to augment what Sriram said — Auditor’s observation has been widely misread. He didn’t qualify his audit opinion, he didn’t issue a going concern conclusion under SA 570, which governs going concern assessments. There’s a clear legal distinction between emphasis of matter and a full qualification. What he issued was a conditional observation, standard practice when receivables exceed the normal aging threshold. The condition he noted was non-collection, that collection is being resolved.
